description: Expanded portal wordmarks use a 48px-high, width-bounded allocation with preserved aspect ratio and left alignment.
Uploaded square portal logos render at 48px expanded and 32px collapsed, without circular cropping or flex shrink.
Portal brand rows contain long names and artwork while preserving variant selection, wordmark failure fallback, label suppression, navigation and collapse persistence.
Dashboard branding preview uses 36px uploaded-logo allocations, uncropped square artwork and width containment.
Portal wide-logo help and its inline default describe scaling to fit in every locale without changing MSP appearance help.
Existing CE/EE gates and built-in 32px fallback remain intact while square-logo improvements apply wherever the client portal sidebar renders.
